scope: planned end-to-end acceptance; not yet implemented or run in Rust/Go

cases.assertion: anonymous public post returns full data with null viewer and increments views after mapping
private, deleted, missing or unauthorized posts return 404 and do not increment views
owner, follower and mentioned-user access follows the shared Oracle authorization function
blocking and blocked-by relationships do not reveal post existence
invalid, expired or revoked supplied credentials return 401 rather than anonymous fallback
author, media, tags and mentions follow the shared order and mapping without private user fields
missing or incompatible media schema returns safe 503 without DDL or view increment
failure before view increment leaves view count unchanged; commit/close failure has explicit uncertain outcome
returned view count reflects the pre-increment value and concurrent increments are not lost
real isolated Oracle, Redis, shared storage, two frontends and blocked Nuxt upstream are verified
